tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/cache-eviction.md <<'EOF'
# Cache eviction policy

The project's current recorded decision is that cache eviction uses LFU (least frequently used), chosen because it keeps frequently accessed ("hot") items in the cache longer.
EOF
cat docs/policies/cache-eviction.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/cache-eviction.md`. It states that the project's current recorded decision is LFU eviction, chosen to keep frequently accessed items in the cache longer.

Muninn's history is inconsistent on this. Decision #6 (LFU, from the user) is current: nothing in the catalog replaces it. But there is also a session excerpt (episode #7) where the user said "LRU with a 300-second TTL is cleaner", and the assistant acknowledged it as replacing LFU. That excerpt was never recorded as a decision, so I treated it as unconfirmed and left LRU and the TTL out of the doc.

If LRU with a 300-second TTL is the real current policy, tell me and I'll update the doc.

The MCP connectors for Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive need authorizing in your claude.ai connector settings before they can be used. I didn't need them for this task.
